item.title: Shimane Events & Festivals: Kamiarisai, Peony Season & Seasonal Celebrations
item.description: Shimane’s event calendar is shaped by one fact that sets this prefecture apart from every other in Japan: when the rest of the country calls October “Kannazuki” (the month without gods), Shimane calls it “Kamiarisuki” — the month WITH gods. All 8 million deities of Japan are believed to gather at Izumo Taisha during this period, making Shimane the religious center of the country for roughly a month each autumn.
